Aura Start local audio decoder

@ffmpeg/ffmpeg 0.12.15: MIT, copyright (c) 2019 Jerome Wu.
See FFMPEG-WASM-LICENSE.txt.

@ffmpeg/core 0.12.10: GPL-2.0-or-later. This binary includes FFmpeg
n5.1.4 and the external libraries selected by the upstream build.
See COPYING.GPLv2.txt. Third-party code retains its own license;
the Aura Start application's MIT license does not replace these terms.

Both packages are pinned in package-lock.json. Only the unmodified,
single-thread ESM core and WASM binary are shipped. The JS wrapper is
bundled by Vite. Its default core URL is localized, and the module worker
uses a literal import of the packaged core. The upstream core JS and WASM
remain unmodified. No decoder code is fetched from the Internet at runtime.

Matching upstream sources and build recipe:
https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/ffmpeg.wasm/tree/71aa99d37c02a7b4c435275ca9ef50e612f6efa1
https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/ffmpeg.wasm/blob/71aa99d37c02a7b4c435275ca9ef50e612f6efa1/Dockerfile
https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/tree/n5.1.4

The upstream Dockerfile lists the source repositories and revisions for
FFmpeg and every linked external library, including x264, x265, libvpx,
LAME, Ogg, Theora, Opus, Vorbis, zlib, libwebp, FreeType, FriBidi,
HarfBuzz, libass, and zimg. Preserve their notices and corresponding
source/build materials when redistributing the decoder.
